heading: Choose your party package
intro: Every package includes a supervised reptile encounter and freshly made pizza for the children.

items.name: Hatchling Party
items.description: Up to 8 children · around 60 minutes · 3-4 reptiles to meet · cheese and pepperoni pizzas · water or squash included

items.name: Reptile Ranger
items.description: Up to 12 children · around 90 minutes · 5-6 reptiles · more handling time · pizza with a choice of toppings · mini reptile quiz

items.name: Ultimate Slither
items.description: Up to 16 children · around 2 hours · 6-8 reptiles · extended handling session · pizza lunch · birthday child keepsake certificate
